text:
nina_sales: Verdant AI wants to POC a custom 'verdant-qlora-13b' variant. They need model catalog onboarding + answers for pricing and security. Can we validate compatibility quickly? cc @arjun_se @lia_ml

arjun_se: Haven't seen that specific variant. Usual checklist: tokenizer, model config, example inputs, and a small weights dump to test quant packing. Also need to confirm tokenizer's special tokens to avoid generation drift.

lia_ml: QLoRA variants sometimes change adapter shapes. Requesting `tokenizer.json`, `config.json`, and a small `<1MB` weights slice or a conversion script. We can run packing locally to detect kernel mismatches.

sami_ops: For BYOK: Dedicated and Private support customer-managed KMS keys. Hosted supports SAML and audit logs; SCIM available on enterprise plan. For data residency they want EU-only — doable on Dedicated in eu-west with reserved capacity.

nina_sales: Pricing ask: rough estimate for a 1-month trial with 4 A100-hours baseline and a 5% canary at traffic. Also customer asked about SLA for latency.

arjun_se: Estimate depends on sustained qps. Rough: dev trial usage + transient reserved buffer ~ $12k-18k for the month for minimal baseline; dedicated commit pricing needed for 24/7. Canary routing: we can add a route tag `canary=verdant` and set 5% weight.

lia_ml: Performance note: QLoRA+4-bit packing can increase KV cache overhead for seq>256. If their L95 target is <350ms for 512 tokens we'll need Dedicated with tuned kernels and low batch.

sami_ops: Action: need artifacts and the answered security questionnaire PDF. infra-bot: created ticket SLS-2338 "verdant-qlora preflight" assigned to arjun_se and lia_ml.

arjun_se: I'll spin a local container and run smoke when assets are in. Please ask customer to upload to our presigned S3 link and include the tokenizer and a short prompt set.

nina_sales: Sending checklist to customer now: tokenizer, config, small weights sample or converter, answered sec questionnaire, BYOK confirmation, EU residency confirmation. ETA back from customer: today EOD. Will update thread when they upload.

lia_ml: If they can't share weights, ask for model pip install name or a conversion script and we can request they run `redwood-validate-packing` cli and share logs.

sami_ops: Also flagged for Legal: they requested SOC2+ISO annex for data processing. I'll loop Legal once questionnaire arrives.

nina_sales: Thanks team, will ping with artifacts.
